grh_c1b48aeea3f741358d6f.title: The Stampede
paragraphs: On a cattle drive Britt rides with an older rancher and the man's younger brother Norm, whose inexperience has already created tension between them. The older brother finds an old love letter from his wife Carrie to Norm and assumes the two have betrayed him, then tries to kill Norm by deliberately setting off the herd in a narrow gorge. Norm risks his own life to save the brother who meant to kill him. As the older man lies mortally injured, Norm explains that Carrie's letter was written before she ever met her husband and that she had never loved Norm after the marriage; the brothers reconcile before the older man dies, and Norm helps Britt finish the drive.

grh_c16404458c0982a9e956.title: Stranger Things
paragraphs: Investment broker Joe Fletcher leaves thirty thousand dollars in bonds with town treasurer Harvey Ziegler, only to learn that Ziegler's safe has apparently been robbed. At the same time Joe's young son Alan suffers vivid recurring dreams containing details that seem to point toward the crime. With no conventional evidence, Dr. Christian uses the dream's clues to confront Ziegler, including a hidden compartment and an arm injury caused by the safe. Ziegler confesses to staging the robbery himself, leaving Dr. Christian unable to explain how Alan knew the truth except to acknowledge that some strange things remain beyond science.

grh_c1b648ffe898badf3918.title: Cemetary
paragraphs: Veteran newspaper columnist Sam Roberts is dismissed by ruthless new publisher Jay Rogers Bridge just before the pension he has spent decades earning.
